name: flowly-desktop
description: Flowly Desktop — Full client with GPU training agent
author: Flowly

scripts.prestart: node scripts/sync-training-script.js && node scripts/sync-clip-index-script.js && node scripts/sync-icons.js
scripts.predev: node scripts/sync-training-script.js && node scripts/sync-clip-index-script.js && node scripts/sync-icons.js
scripts.build:app: npm run build:renderer && npm run sync-training && npm run sync-icons && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run sync-training && npm run sync-icons && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:renderer && npm run sync-training && npm run sync-icons && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:renderer && npm run sync-training && npm run sync-icons && electron-builder --linux
